launch_wave_rules.$comment: Product-level waves aligned to the DCR Rev24 DRAFT launch-wave map (P10, sheet 47_REV24_LAUNCH_WAVE_MAP, 1 Nov 2026). Conservative defaults flagged for Dan: Transition and AI Governance packs 'later' (workbook: Dec 2026 / Q2 2027 earliest, 'by wave'); HRCW, Audit/Risk and other specialist packs, Labour Hire and Toolbox 'later' (the DCR rows for Risk/Audit/Toolbox are jun-2027 through the app modules, not as FORMS packs); Design/Contract/Project Delivery 'later' (Dan to decide later vs gated). First match wins, in this order. '*' matches one pack-id segment. Only waves in purchasable_waves can be bought; 'gated' products (CORE, SiteGuard AI, robotics, NZ/overseas) are never listed, priced or quoted customer-facing.
